titulo: A Study of Rapastinel as Adjunctive Therapy in the Prevention of Relapse in Patients With Major Depressive Disorder

braco.texto: Rapastinel 450 milligrams (mg) intravenous (IV) once a week during OLTP followed by rapastinel 450 mg IV once a week during DBTP.
braco.textoPt: Rapastinel 450 miligramas (mg) intravenoso (IV) uma vez por semana durante OLTP seguido de rapastinel 450 mg IV uma vez por semana durante DBTP.

titulo: A Study of Rapastinel as Adjunctive Therapy in Major Depressive Disorder (RAP-MD-02)

braco.texto: Rapastinel 225 milligram (mg) weekly intravenous (IV) injections. Each participant will continue to take the same dose of antidepressant therapy the participant was receiving prior to entering this study throughout treatment.
braco.textoPt: Rapastinel 225 miligramas (mg) injeções intravenosas (IV) semanais. Cada participante continuará a tomar a mesma dose de terapia antidepressiva que o participante estava recebendo antes de entrar neste estudo durante todo o tratamento.
